```{r}

# ========= Input file =========
input_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/MSK_IMPACT/pILC_IMPACT_filtered.tsv"

# ========= Read IMPACT TSV =========
impact <- read.delim(
  input_file,
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# ========= Merge Splice_Region into Splice_Site =========
impact <- impact %>%
  mutate(
    Variant_Classification = ifelse(
      Variant_Classification == "Splice_Region",
      "Splice_Site",
      Variant_Classification
    )
  )

# ========= Define non-synonymous classes =========
nonsyn_classes <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation",
  "Nonsense_Mutation",
  "Frame_Shift_Del",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins",
  "In_Frame_Del",
  "In_Frame_Ins",
  "Splice_Site",
  "Translation_Start_Site"
)

# ========= Filter to non-synonymous only =========
impact_filt <- impact %>%
  filter(Variant_Classification %in% nonsyn_classes)
```


```{r}
# ===============================
# Load and merge OncoVar annotations
# ===============================
tcga_df <- fread("/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Reference/TCGA.BRCA.onco.genes.OncoVar.tsv") %>%
  mutate(Source = "TCGA")

icgc_df <- fread("/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Reference/ICGC.BRCA.onco.genes.OncoVar.tsv") %>%
  mutate(Source = "ICGC")

combined_df <- bind_rows(tcga_df, icgc_df)

gene_roles <- combined_df %>%
  group_by(Gene_symbol) %>%
  summarise(
    is_oncogene = any(
      str_detect(
        paste(OncoKB, OncoVar, `2020Rule`, CTAT, HCD, Intogen, Oncogene),
        regex("oncogene", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    is_tsg = any(
      str_detect(
        paste(OncoKB, OncoVar, `2020Rule`, CTAT, HCD, Intogen, TSgene),
        regex("tsg", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cancer_role = case_when(
      is_oncogene & !is_tsg ~ "Oncogene",
      is_tsg & !is_oncogene ~ "TSG",
      is_tsg & is_oncogene  ~ "Dual",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

metadata_cols <- c(
  "Gene_symbol", "Gene_biotype", "OncoKB", "OncoVar", "MutPanning",
  "2020Rule", "CTAT", "HCD", "Intogen", "Oncogene", "TSgene"
)

gene_metadata_full <- combined_df %>%
  arrange(Gene_symbol, desc(Source)) %>%
  distinct(Gene_symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(all_of(metadata_cols))

cgc_df <- left_join(gene_roles, gene_metadata_full, by = "Gene_symbol") %>%
  rename(OverlapGenes = Gene_symbol)

cgc_genes <- unique(cgc_df$OverlapGenes)
```


```{r}
# ========= Build MAF-like data.frame =========
maf_df <- impact_filt %>%
  mutate(
    Variant_Type = case_when(
      nchar(REF) == 1 & nchar(ALT) == 1 ~ "SNP",
      nchar(REF) == 1 & nchar(ALT) > 1 ~ "INS",
      nchar(REF) > 1 & nchar(ALT) == 1 ~ "DEL",
      TRUE ~ "ONP"
    ),
    t_alt_count = round(TUMOR_DP * TUMOR_MAF),
    t_ref_count = pmax(TUMOR_DP - t_alt_count, 0),
    n_alt_count = round(NORMAL_DP * NORMAL_MAF),
    n_ref_count = pmax(NORMAL_DP - n_alt_count, 0)
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    Hugo_Symbol = SYMBOL,
    Chromosome = CHROM,
    Start_Position = POS,
    End_Position = POS,
    Reference_Allele = REF,
    Tumor_Seq_Allele1 = REF,
    Tumor_Seq_Allele2 = ALT,
    Variant_Classification = Variant_Classification,
    Variant_Type = Variant_Type,
    Tumor_Sample_Barcode = TUMOR_SAMPLE,
    Matched_Norm_Sample_Barcode = NORMAL_SAMPLE,
    t_depth = TUMOR_DP,
    n_depth = NORMAL_DP,
    t_ref_count = t_ref_count,
    t_alt_count = t_alt_count,
    n_ref_count = n_ref_count,
    n_alt_count = n_alt_count,
    TUMOR_MAF = TUMOR_MAF,
    NORMAL_MAF = NORMAL_MAF,
    AF = AF,
    ExAC_AF = ExAC_AF,
    LOH = LOH,
    HOTSPOT = HOTSPOT,
    variantCaller = variantCaller,
    HGVSp_Short = HGVSp_Short,
    ID = ID
  )

# ========= Keep only OncoVar genes =========
maf_df_oncovar <- maf_df %>%
  filter(Hugo_Symbol %in% cgc_genes)

cat("Total mutations in MAF:", nrow(maf_df), "\n")
cat("Mutations in OncoVar genes:", nrow(maf_df_oncovar), "\n")
cat("Unique OncoVar genes mutated:", length(unique(maf_df_oncovar$Hugo_Symbol)), "\n")
```


```{r}
# ========= Create MAF object =========
impact_maf_oncovar <- read.maf(maf = maf_df_oncovar)

# ========= Order genes by mutation frequency =========
gene_order <- getGeneSummary(impact_maf_oncovar) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(MutatedSamples), desc(total)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Hugo_Symbol)

print(getSampleSummary(impact_maf_oncovar)[1:5, ])
print(getGeneSummary(impact_maf_oncovar)[1:10, ])

# ========= Plot =========
oncoplot(
  maf = impact_maf_oncovar,
  genes = gene_order,
  sortByAnnotation = TRUE,
  removeNonMutated = TRUE
)
```


```{r}
# ========= Save as PDF =========

)
```
